name: project-sprint-manager
description: Project & Sprint Management application (FastAPI + MongoDB + Next.js)

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check .
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format . && npm --prefix frontend run format
